title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-95} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-18 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `877674189458811120675057777198923075106017017/492490285056000`, which is strictly greater than `2^{95}*(319/100) = 3159222980256290461542565019648/25`.
- The degree-17 partial sum is strictly below that target, and the next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-95}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-95}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=5` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
- The parent commits are #4367, #4368 and #4369. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c5` and replays those predecessors.
